result.title: Navigent: A Geometry-Grounded Agentic Framework for Vision Language Navigation
result.summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) with general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offers a flexible alternative to task-specific navigation policies, while reliable long-horizon execution remains challenging. Agents must track navigation progress, detect discrepancies between commanded and actual motion, and recognize when movement has passed relevant landmarks or entrances. We present Navigent, an agentic VLN framework built around a frozen MLLM and a Geometry-Grounded Execution Critic (GEC). GEC performs two complementary checks: action-to-motion consistency, which evaluates measured displacement against commanded movement, and motion-to-landmark consistency, which tracks agent-selected visual anchors and entrance candidates in world coordinates. Detected discrepancies interrupt the remaining action sequence and trigger reobservation, local adjustment, or node-based recovery. Historical visual memory supports progress tracking across extended routes. An offline self-improvement procedure further analyzes successful and failed training trajectories to refine navigation prompts and GEC logic while keeping model weights fixed. On the R2R-CE validation-unseen split (1,839 episodes) and RxR-CE validation-unseen split(3,669 episodes), Navigent achieves 84.0%/86.0% SR and 72.9%/69.1% SPL, respectively, demonstrating the value of geometry-grounded execution verification for reliable agentic navigation. Project Page: https://marslab-navigent.github.io/navigent.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/MarsLab-Navigent/Navigent

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Navigent：以冻结 MLLM 为导航智能体，外加几何落地的执行评论器 GEC，用动作—位移一致性与运动—地标一致性检测偏差，中断动作序列并触发重观察或恢复，另以离线自改进优化提示与 GEC 逻辑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其外部评论器在动作序列中途核验并触发重观察，与 LVR 中的证据获取、验证与停止/回退决策线索相关；但该几何检验发生在导航状态而非 latent 推理状态，迁移价值需核查，离线固定权重下改提示与评论逻辑也提供贡献分配的旁证。
